paper_title: Joint Detection of Fraud and Concept Drift inOnline Conversations with   LLM-Assisted Judgment
caption: A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of the runtime performance of several models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis, labeled "Models," displays the names of the models in alphabetical order: Our Joint Framework, DeepSeek, Claude, LLaMA, ChatGPT, and Large Language Models (LLM) Models. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds),” represents the execution time in seconds, ranging from approximately 77 to 365, with a linear scale and tick intervals of 50 seconds. The bar corresponding to Our Joint Framework is dark green and has a height of approximately 243 seconds, while the bar representing the LLM Models is light blue and reaches a height of approximately 365 seconds. The bar for ChatGPT is light blue and measures 190 seconds. The bar for DeepSeek is light blue and measures 172 seconds, and the bar for LLaMA is light blue and measures 77 seconds. No bars are visually emphasized or sorted in any particular order, and the chart displays a clear distinction in runtime between the Our Joint Framework and the other models presented.
